gloss: print medium; paper format; hard copy

definitions.gloss: print medium; paper format; hard copy
definitions.explanation: Information or content published in printed form on paper, as opposed to digital or electronic formats. Commonly used in discussions contrasting traditional and digital media.

examples.japanese: {紙媒体|かみばいたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新聞|しんぶん}→新聞：01440_shinbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいる→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read the newspaper in print.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{紙媒体|かみばいたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦もらえます→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Can I get this material in print format?

examples.japanese: {紙媒体|かみばいたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{減少|げんしょう}している→減少する：19026_genshousuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{電子書籍|でんししょせき}→電子書籍：16435_denshishoseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{伸|の}びている→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
examples.english: Sales of print media are declining year by year, but e-books are growing.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧ (paper) + ⟦{媒体|ばいたい}→媒体：12248_baitai⟧ (medium). Frequently used in business, publishing, and media contexts to distinguish physical printed materials from their digital counterparts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {紙媒体|かみばいたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本|ほん}: a physical book
- {紙媒体|かみばいたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{配布|はいふ}→配布：14410_haifu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to distribute in print form
- {紙媒体|かみばいたい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{電子化|でんしか}→電子化：15001_denshika⟧: digitization from paper

CONTRASTED WITH:
- {電子媒体|でんしばいたい}: electronic/digital medium
- ⟦{電子書籍|でんししょせき}→電子書籍：16435_denshishoseki⟧: e-book
- {デジタル版|でじたるばん}: digital edition
- {ウェブ版|うぇぶばん}: web edition

USAGE:
Often used in the pattern {紙媒体|かみばいたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (in print format) as an adverbial phrase. In business meetings, you may hear people ask {紙媒体|かみばいたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦いただけます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (could I have a hard copy?).
